from fraud_detection import FraudDetection
from error_handling import ErrorHandling

from distributed_load_balancing import DistributedLoadBalancing
from reporting import Reporting

    def __init__(self, payment_gateways: List[PaymentGateway], user_segments: List[UserSegment], fraud_detection: FraudDetection, error_handling: ErrorHandling, caching: Caching, distributed_load_balancing: DistributedLoadBalancing, reporting: Reporting):

        self.fraud_detection = fraud_detection
        self.error_handling = error_handling
        self.caching = caching
        self.distributed_load_balancing = distributed_load_balancing
        self.reporting = reporting

        # Perform fraud detection and anomaly detection
        fraud_detection_result = self.fraud_detection.detect_fraud(subscription)
        if fraud_detection_result is not None:
            # If fraud detected, return error message and suggest recovery actions

            return SubscriptionStatus(status="FAILED", message=error_message)

        # Perform async processing using distributed load balancing
        async_process = self.distributed_load_balancing.submit_async_job(subscription)
        while not async_process.done():
            time.sleep(1)

        # Get result of asynchronous processing
        subscription_status = async_process.result()
        if subscription_status == SubscriptionStatus.FAILED:
            error_message = "Error processing subscription {}: {}".format(subscription.id, subscription_status)
            self.error_handling.log_error(error_message)
            return subscription_status

        # Perform user segment validation and plan validation

                self.error_handling.log_warning(error_message)

        logging.info("Subscription {}: Successfully processed.".format(subscription.id))
